title: Add About page and navigation link

requirements.summary: Create an About page that renders the provided “About Me” bio/mission text for Genuine Being Real, including the debut novel mention.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to an About route renders an About page with the full user-provided text in English, preserving punctuation and meaning (including “Genuine Being Real” and “Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown”).
The About page layout matches the existing warm editorial theme (typography, spacing, background colors) and is readable on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add a new AboutPage component that displays the full provided “About Me” text verbatim (including “Genuine Being Real” and “Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown”), styled to match the existing warm editorial theme using existing Tailwind/theme tokens and composed existing UI components (e.g., Card/typography patterns) without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Add an /about route in TanStack Router and wire it to the new About page component.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has a new route at /about that is reachable via client-side navigation (no full page reload required).

file_operations.description: Register a new TanStack Router route at path /about, import and wire it to AboutPage, and include it in the root route children so it works with client-side navigation while preserving existing routes (/ , /submit, /story/$title, /admin).

requirements.summary: Add a visible About link in the global layout footer while keeping existing footer content unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer includes an “About” link (English label) that navigates to /about.
The existing footer line “© 2026. Built with love using caffeine.ai” remains present and functional.

file_operations.description: Add a visible “About” navigation link in the footer that routes to /about (client-side) using TanStack Router Link, while keeping the existing footer line “© 2026. Built with love using caffeine.ai” intact and functional (including the external caffeine.ai link).
